title: Stop Calling GPT an AI Agent
description:
🔹Download the free guide from HubSpot on Your 2026 Guide to
AI Agents: https://clickhubspot.com/70c662

GPT isn't an AI agent, and here's the real difference. Ask a chatbot to find your top blog posts and write social content, and it hands you a numbered list of steps to do yourself, basically a search engine with good manners. 

An actual agent does the work: connects your analytics, pulls the top posts, drafts the content, and schedules it for you. A chatbot takes your question and gives an answer. An agent takes your goal and gives you the finished result. The difference comes down to three things: memory, tools, and autonomy. 

The test? Give it a task, leave the room.

#techwithtim #ai #aiengineer
